name: @projectx-social/signer
comment: exports points at TypeScript source rather than dist, matching @projectx-social/agent and @projectx-social/mcp. There is no tsconfig.build.json here yet, so naming a dist entry point would name a directory nothing produces. Note the dependency list: @mysten/sui, the workspace SDK and the workspace policy evaluator, and nothing else. There is deliberately no cloud KMS SDK — see src/kms.ts, which fixes the interface without taking the dependency.
devDependencyComment: @mysten/seal is a DEV dependency and must stay one. No file under src/ imports it, and none should: this package produces signatures and Seal reads content. It is here for test/custody-compat.test.ts alone, which answers by execution whether Seal's SessionKey accepts a multisig or secp256r1 signer — because if it does not, MultiSigSigner cannot be the custody floor and a multisig agent could pay for content it then could not read. The version is pinned to the one the rest of the workspace runs; a test that answers that question against a different version answers nothing.
